hypothesis: Inventory and turnover create delayed consequences; bounded sequential policies might improve net exposure decisions over a myopic cost-aware policy. This screen tests mechanics and falsifies fragile candidates; it cannot establish adoption.
priorEvidence: The exact 4,910-bar development panel has informed 45 previous residual/funding trials. It is contaminated development evidence, including every later fold. Attempt 46 and all prospective registrations remain separate and untouched. This is a new sequential-control mechanism, not another reversal sizing retry.

data.coverageLimitations: Fixed survivor panel, close-only prices, no original bar publication witnesses, no L2, and no equivalent Coinbase/Kraken perpetual fills. No synthetic replacement of missing fleet or venues. 1h/4h and point-in-time ranking are not tested.
data.availability: Research assumption: completed close observed at close plus 1 millisecond; fill at a later close. This assumption is not recorded first-seen evidence and blocks promotion.
data.permittedInputs: Only the two exact hash-pinned registered-development files. Never read raw full snapshots, final holdout, prospective campaign data, production database, or credentials.

validation.indexConvention: zero-based source bar indexes; stop exclusive; all outcomes must be strictly before stop
validation.preprocessing: Fit mean/std and support ranges on training rows only; immutable at evaluation; no imputation.
validation.innerSelection: No hyperparameter, checkpoint, reward, seed, or model selection. Fixed last update for every seed; therefore nested selection is inapplicable to this screen. Any future selection requires a new nested registration.
validation.finalHoldout: No final holdout is allocated or authorized for this screen. The earlier 1,227-return holdout and active 2026-07-17 through 2027-01-20 prospective carry outcomes remain prohibited. A later confirmation needs a new future-data registration; none is claimed here.
validation.crossSymbol: Shared training policy pools training prefixes only; report every symbol independently and equal-capital descriptive aggregate. No cross-sectional rank hypothesis.

environment.formulation: Partially observed inventory-control process; observed market history is not asserted Markov. The simulator is an exogenous historical replay MDP conditional on its clock. Full RL must beat the myopic control baseline.
environment.hiddenState: Liquidity, latent market regimes, unavailable orders and participant inventory; no POMDP optimality claim.
environment.actionMeaning: absolute proposed target exposure; at most one pending proposal; pending orders cannot be replaced before processing
environment.actionFrequency: every 1, 3, or 6 bars in independent experiments
environment.mask: Unavailable observation, unsupported action, disabled policy, invalid price, non-finite action, timeout, or state mismatch rejects proposal. Terminal failure is not a manufactured flat continuation.
environment.reward: 100 * (equity_after - equity_before) / equity_before minus 100 * 0.01 * sum(exposure_before_bar^2 * trailing_24bar_variance). Equity includes fees, spread, slippage, funding, impact sensitivity, and terminal liquidation. Reward penalty is not included in reported economic PnL.
environment.rewardNormalization: fixed 100 scale; no running normalization; no reward clipping
environment.episodeStart: seeded uniform symbol and start entirely within training prefix, at least 24 bars of causal warmup, starts from cash
environment.episodeTermination: registered end or any invalid state/risk breach; terminal liquidation charged once; no bootstrap after terminal
environment.terminalState: pending proposals cancelled; open inventory liquidated at last valid price with full costs; failed or exhausted paths remain failures
environment.execution: Decision at completed close t. Old units earn price PnL and pay each actual settlement through next endpoint. Fill proposed target at close t+1; added-delay stress fills at t+2. New units use pre-fill equity; costs reduce equity. Units drift between fills. No same-close profit for a newly proposed action.
environment.funding: Every registered event in (leftClose,rightClose] uses -units * causalMark * rate, before the endpoint fill; no future funding observation enters the policy.
environment.executionLimitations: No empirically identified partial-fill, queue, minimum-notional, precision, margin, intrabar liquidation, or endogenous impact model. Sensitivities do not cure missing evidence.
environment.shield: Research-only hard 0.25 target, 0.35 endpoint exposure, 0.50 activation turnover, 15% drawdown, 0.80 minimum equity. Fail and record breach; do not clip returns or fabricate continuation. No order adapter exists. Production controls are unchanged.
environment.behaviorPolicy: Seeded uniform random over three bounded targets, simulated training prefixes only; propensity exactly 1/3. Logs describe counterfactual replay, never actual exchange behavior.
environment.exploration: PPO categorical policy, DDQN epsilon=0.20, CQL no online interaction after fixed behavior buffer creation; all in simulation only
environment.evaluationPolicy: deterministic argmax with fixed action order and abstention on invalid/OOD observations
environment.fallback: Reject proposal; terminate invalid replay with explicit reason. Never authorize real liquidation or any order.

algorithms.ppo: one hidden tanh layer with 16 units, separate value head, categorical clipped surrogate epsilon=0.2, GAE lambda=0.95, Adam lr=0.0003, four epochs per 256-transition rollout, entropy coefficient=0, value coefficient=0.5, global gradient norm<=1
algorithms.double_dqn: 16-unit tanh network, uniform replay, Double-Q online argmax/target evaluation, Adam lr=0.001, batch=64, target sync every 100 updates, epsilon=0.20, one update per collected transition after 64 warmup
algorithms.cql: discrete CQL(H) logsumexp(Q)-Q(behavior action) weight=0.1 added to Double-Q squared Bellman loss; fixed 4096-transition uniform behavior buffer, 4096 gradient updates, same network/lr/batch/target sync
algorithms.cql_no_inventory_penalty: registered ablation identical to CQL except inventory reward coefficient=0
algorithms.deviations: Small CPU networks and fixed budgets are mechanism prototypes, not benchmark reproductions. No claim of original paper scores or conservative lower-bound guarantees under function approximation and market shift.
algorithms.exclusions: Continuous SAC/TD3 inapplicable to chosen discrete actions. Distributional networks deferred in favor of explicit inventory-risk penalty plus external hard constraints and ES reporting. Decision Transformer, world models, hierarchical and multi-agent policies lack diverse trajectories, calibrated impact, and causal action coverage.

unavailableBaselineGate: Current adopted fleet, champion and all Haskell sensors require matched causal feature/forecast and execution export. They are not replaced with Python lookalikes. No champion-superiority claim or promotion is allowed without that comparison.

budget.accounting: Every algorithm x horizon x seed x fold and every baseline/stress replay gets its own registry row before execution. Training exceptions and risk failures remain rows. No adaptive successor permitted; earlier 46 attempts remain disclosed. Repeated exact tests are engineering checks, not independent financial trials.

forecast: calibration bins for logistic baseline only
metrics.statistics: Reuse diagnostics.py DSR and CSCV PBO on complete aligned trial-return matrices only; undefined for constant paths and unavailable for stopped incomplete paths. No dropping failed or cash columns to manufacture significance. Paired circular-block bootstrap (blocks 3,9,21 bars; 1000 replicates; seed 20260917), report unadjusted and Bonferroni family bounds. Reality Check/SPA require complete valid comparable paths; unavailable means gate failed.
metrics.OPE: Ordinary trajectory IS, per-decision IS, weighted IS, DR with training-only reward/value baseline where valid, and direct historical replay. Uniform logged propensities. Use short six-decision episodes for overlap; full-horizon support cannot be inferred. Report ESS and bootstrap uncertainty; ESS<100 or material estimator disagreement fails OPE gate. No clipping favorable weights.

artifacts: Small JSON registration, result summaries, registry, hashes, source/license manifests, tests and docs in Git. Return paths, replay buffers and policy parameter artifacts outside Git, hashed with source/registration/schema/seed metadata. No pickle; strict finite JSON, bounded shape and file size; no production loader.
reproduction: Commit registration; implement and test on deterministic fixtures; freeze clean source commit; explicitly invoke offline runner with two hash-pinned development CSVs and a new external output directory. No code path to protected data or exchange endpoints.
